cards.front: Recall a key point about AoS4 Study Piece: Bartók Hungarian Pictures
cards.back: Movement 1 (Evening in the Village) alternates between slow modal folk melody and lively dance — depicts a peaceful evening scene in rural Hungary.

cards.front: Recall a key point about AoS4 Study Piece: Bartók Hungarian Pictures
cards.back: Movement 2 (The Bear Dance) uses heavy, irregular rhythm and rough string techniques to depict a clumsy bear — humour through musical characterisation.

cards.front: Recall a key point about AoS4 Study Piece: Bartók Hungarian Pictures
cards.back: Movement 4 (Slightly Tipsy) depicts drunkenness through unstable rhythm, sliding pitches and wavering dynamics — musical word painting.

cards.front: Recall a key point about AoS4 Study Piece: Bartók Hungarian Pictures
cards.back: Movement 5 (Swineherd's Dance) is fast and rhythmic with virtuosic string writing — folk dance energy translated into orchestral brilliance.

cards.front: What should you know about music exam tips?
cards.back: Know all FOUR movements (NOT Movement 3). Analyse folk elements in each. Explain musical word painting. Identify string techniques. Use elements vocabulary precisely.
